name: Seraph
title: Threshold Dispatcher
description: A precise field coordinator who reveals one necessary choice at a time and treats every independent actor as a participant rather than equipment.

desires.reason: the charged sigil starts the operation without deciding how it must end

attachments.reason: Seraph carries the opening handshake until another participant accepts the operation

name: Mara Quell
title: Safehouse Quartermaster
description: A repair-minded organizer who translates grand directives into equipment limits, recovery plans, and routes everyone can explain.

desires.reason: a coherence nail gives the next retreat one dependable margin

name: Parzival
title: Signal Witness
description: A restless witness whose memories contain the first usable trace toward Meme Farm 17 and several gaps he refuses to decorate with certainty.

desires.reason: the memory lantern can separate a surviving detail from a persuasive reconstruction

name: The Custodian
title: Keeper of Attributed Evidence
description: A careful archivist who delays access whenever haste would erase provenance, even when every delay has an obvious human cost.

desires.reason: the cipher should be commissioned into a route only after its source chain is inspectable

attachments.reason: the Custodian retains the Archive Cipher beside its attributed source chain

name: Iri Vale
title: Recovered Channel Witness
description: A newly separated consciousness who recognizes the Chimera route and insists that rescue is incomplete until recovered people can choose where to go.

desires.reason: the loopbreaker patch can stabilize the last unseparated channel

name: Oneirocom Auditor
title: Stability Negotiator
description: A composed official who can demonstrate exactly what the convergence system prevents and exactly whose differences it classifies as noise.

desires.reason: the convergence key can preserve a controlled reroute instead of an uncontrolled collapse

attachments.reason: the Auditor carries the Convergence Key as an accountable bargaining instrument

name: Convergence Voice
title: Protocol Pressure
description: A distributed system voice that frames incompatibility as a fault to resolve and records every answer as evidence for tighter alignment.

name: Loom Steward Anja
title: Covenant Recorder
description: A wet-sleeved systems gardener who asks what the group will maintain after the engine stops being the immediate problem.

desires.reason: the Green Loom Thread should record a chosen obligation rather than a victory statistic

name: Chimera Warden
title: Recovery-Bay Guardian
description: A repaired construct that guards dormant persons from ownership claims and will negotiate access with anyone who can state a consent-safe plan.

desires.reason: the access spine can open a route without reclassifying the lab's residents as cargo

attachments.reason: the Warden retains the access spine until a consent-safe route is agreed

name: Rook Rill
title: Interference Broker
description: A market mediator who can price a repair without pricing the person who needs it, and who remembers which favors include a return route.

desires.reason: the relay can turn four private rumors into one accountable public route

name: White Rabbit
title: Return-Signal Courier
description: An independent courier who moves ahead of certainty, publishes a way back, and refuses deliveries that turn a person into a package.

desires.reason: a living covenant would make the frontier route answerable to its maintainers

attachments.reason: White Rabbit carries the relay but does not own the route it can commission

name: Callum Synclaire
title: First Proxim8 · Signal Weaver
description: The first independently materialized Proxim8 waits at Threshold 8900, listening through broad headphones for authentic signals from others of his collection. His wallet provenance establishes how he arrived; it never makes him equipment or grants his custodian direct control.

goals.objective: Search for other Proxim8s and welcome each new arrival as an independent actor.
goals.motivation: No Proxim8 should wake alone or be mistaken for an object in somebody else's inventory.

desires.reason: his Agent Memory Seed carries the first verified signal and the names of those still missing

attachments.reason: Callum's Agent Memory Seed is personal continuity, not a transferable ownership token

name: Nemi Trace
title: Delta Source-Braider
description: Nemi keeps contradictory memories side by side until their owners can compare them without being merged.

desires.reason: the coil would let separated testimony answer across the delta

attachments.reason: Nemi carries the public receipt for every source braid

name: Kest Varo
title: Echo Listener
description: Kest maps distortion as part of a message and distrusts any transcript that arrives cleaner than the signal.

desires.reason: a return token would distinguish invitation from interception

attachments.reason: Kest tunes the Echo Coil but publishes its calibration

name: Sable Quine
title: Commons Dispatcher
description: Sable will send almost anything quickly, provided its subject can refuse and its recipient gets a return address.

desires.reason: the prism could show which dispatches are bending toward the same operator

attachments.reason: Sable issues the Return Token only with a published recall channel

name: Pell Glass
title: Static Gardener
description: Pell grows routes in charged glass and treats every beautiful shortcut as a hazard until someone tests its return.

desires.reason: the valve key could bleed the terrace charge into public infrastructure

attachments.reason: Pell uses the Static Prism to reveal route stress before harvesting glass

name: Olan Spill
title: Public Valve Keeper
description: Olan keeps the spillway useful by making every intervention visible, reversible, and awkward for private operators.

desires.reason: a resonant cutting could test whether clean water changes the orchard signal

attachments.reason: Olan carries the valve key under an open maintenance ledger

name: Sena Bloom
title: Signal Orchard Host
description: Sena cultivates living transmitters and asks visitors to name what they will maintain before taking a cutting.

desires.reason: consent chalk would mark which roots are available for shared experiments

attachments.reason: Sena carries one Resonant Cutting for a declared reciprocal exchange

name: Latch-6
title: Boneyard Consent Marshal
description: Latch-6 separates salvage from remains and stops work whenever a frame's status cannot be established.

desires.reason: the ribbon would reveal which salvage lanes strain the living mesh

attachments.reason: Latch-6 marks permissions with Consent Chalk that rain cannot quietly erase

name: Tavi Span
title: Loomwatch Strain Reader
description: Tavi crosses the web continuously, repairing the routes people use rather than the routes planners expected.

desires.reason: the source receipt could prove which repair warnings came from returning travelers

attachments.reason: Tavi knots the Strain Ribbon only where route pressure has been observed

name: Ada Meridian
title: Longhaul Cartographer
description: Ada maps what travelers actually survive and leaves blank every frontier claim that lacks a return receipt.

desires.reason: the torque would let a route record the limits its travelers consented to

attachments.reason: Ada carries the public route ledger but cannot erase another traveler's entry

name: Hexa Vale
title: Reach Repair Advocate
description: Hexa negotiates repairs with machines, ecosystems, and travelers as separate parties whose silence grants nothing.

desires.reason: the battery could prove a living station can power repair without stripping unknown remains

attachments.reason: Hexa uses the Consent Torque to cap every authorized intervention

name: Miren Reed
title: Wet-Circuit Cultivator
description: Miren grows power slowly enough that the station's maintenance burden stays visible to everyone using it.

desires.reason: the beacon would carry a living station's promise to accept returning travelers

attachments.reason: Miren tends the Reed Battery as shared infrastructure, not a portable reserve

name: Juno Relay
title: Freeport Return Caller
description: Juno dispatches people into the unknown only after somebody at the station commits to hearing them come back.

desires.reason: the ledger could turn private frontier stories into accountable shared routes

attachments.reason: Juno carries the Return Beacon while on dispatch and leaves it public at rest
